hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A buyback hook that maintains a "pot" of a designated main token: in beforeSwap, it absorbs sell-side pressure by filling sells against the pot at the pool's own price via BeforeSwapDelta (shield); in afterSwap, it buys back main tokens using accumulated secondary tokens (pump). Supports a hook-managed LP position with auto-harvest, auto-compound, buyback, and burn splits.
